transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Well… it’s about our kitchen. The contractor, and some people on our block, I think they’ve been working together somehow. It’s been nearly two years, and no matter what my husband shows me—receipts, explanations—it still feels like they’re keeping it wrong on purpose.
Do you believe for certain that the contractor and your neighbors are working together against you?

Yes… I do. I mean, I can’t prove every little thing, but I’ve been sure for a long time that the contractor and some people on the block are… quietly working together. To cheat us, I suppose, and keep the kitchen wrong on purpose. My husband shows me receipts and gives explanations, but it doesn’t change what I think.
Have you heard voices when no one else was there?
No… I don’t think so. I mean, not like voices talking when nobody’s there. I haven’t noticed anything like that.
Have there been times when you felt unusually energetic and needed much less sleep than usual?
No… not really. I don’t think I’ve had times like that. My sleep isn’t something I’ve noticed changing that way.
Have you been feeling depressed most of the day nearly every day?
I don’t know… not most of the day, no. I get upset, but I wouldn’t say depressed nearly every day.
Do you find yourself repeatedly checking the kitchen or the receipts over and over because of these thoughts?

I do check sometimes, yes. The receipts, the kitchen work… because it just doesn’t add up. My husband keeps showing me papers, but I still feel like the contractor and some people around here have been working together, keeping it wrong on purpose. It’s been going on a long time.
Have you found yourself losing interest in things you used to care about?
I’m not sure. I still do the things I care about, more or less. Maybe I don’t enjoy everything the same, but… I haven’t really thought of it that way.
Have other people said that you seem emotionally flat or less expressive than you used to be?
I don’t think so. No one’s really said that to me… at least not that I remember.
Have you felt as if someone was putting thoughts into your mind that were not your own?

No… not like someone putting thoughts in my head. It’s more that I know something isn’t right with the contractor and people on the block. The kitchen, the receipts… it’s been nearly two years, and it still feels like they’re keeping it wrong on purpose.
Aside from the kitchen situation, do you generally find it hard to trust other people?
No… I wouldn’t say generally. I still go to church things, book club, keep up with the house and family plans like I usually do. It’s mostly the remodel situation that’s been… difficult.
Do you believe anything impossible is being done to your kitchen, like something happening that could not occur in real life?

No… I don’t mean impossible like magic or anything. It’s real-life things. I just think the contractor, and maybe some people around the block, have been working together to keep it wrong and cheat us. My husband shows receipts, but… it doesn’t explain it to me.
Has this situation caused major problems for you in your daily life, like at work, at home, or with other people?

Not really major, no. I mean… when it’s about the remodel, it upsets me. But outside of that, I still go to my church gatherings, book club, keep the house going, family plans… those things are mostly the same.
Have you ever felt that your thoughts were being broadcast so that other people could know them without you saying anything?
No… I don’t think so. I’ve never had the sense people could hear my thoughts like that.
Have you ever felt that outside forces were controlling your actions or movements?
No… I don’t think so. I move how I mean to move. I haven’t noticed anything like that.
Have other people told you that your speech is hard to follow or that you jump from one idea to another?
No… not that I can think of. People don’t usually say I’m hard to follow. I suppose I can get a little sidetracked sometimes, but nothing anyone’s complained about.
Have you ever felt that other people could influence your thoughts without speaking to you?
I don’t think so. I mean… people can say things that make me think, of course, but not without speaking to me.
Outside of the kitchen remodel, have you often suspected that other people were trying to harm, cheat, or deceive you?

Mostly it’s the kitchen, but… yes, I suppose it goes beyond just the contractor. Some people on the block seem to be in on it, or at least helping him cover things up. It’s been almost two years of excuses, and even when my husband shows me receipts, it doesn’t sit right. It feels like they’re trying to cheat us and leave things wrong on purpose.
Before the kitchen remodel began, did you usually tend to suspect that other people were trying to take advantage of you?
I’m not sure. I didn’t really think about it that way before… I just dealt with things as they came up.
Have you ever believed that something impossible was happening to your kitchen?

Impossible? No… I wouldn’t say impossible. It’s more that I’m sure the contractor, and maybe some people around the block, have been working together to cheat us and leave the kitchen wrong on purpose. My husband keeps showing me receipts, but it still doesn’t feel right.
If someone gave you definite proof that the contractor had done nothing wrong, would you be able to accept that?

I don’t know. If it was really definite… maybe I’d try. But I’ve been sure for so long that something’s been wrong on purpose, with him and maybe people on the block. Even when my husband shows me receipts, it still doesn’t sit right.
